# Aishwari Sirur — AI Engineer

> Aishwari Sirur is a Computer Science student at UC Davis (concentrations in
> Technology Management and Statistics) working at the intersection of AI/ML,
> data science, and product. She builds machine-learning systems and does the
> data, research, product, and design work around them. She is seeking a
> **summer 2026 AI engineering internship**.

This file is a plain-text summary of https://aishwarisirur.com for language
models and automated readers. Everything below is factual; follow the links for
detail.

## Positioning

- **Target role:** AI Engineering / Machine Learning internship (Summer 2026).
- **Core strength:** end-to-end range — she can prototype an ML model, clean and
  analyze the data behind it, and shape and design the product it lives in.
- **Currently learning:** LLM fine-tuning and agentic workflows.

## Education

- **UC Davis** — B.S. Computer Science; concentrations in Technology Management
  and Statistics.

## Skills

- **AI / ML & Data:** Python, Scikit-Learn, Machine Learning, Statistics,
  geospatial data, survey/experimental data processing, Tableau. Learning: LLM
  fine-tuning, agentic workflows.
- **Product:** Figma, Notion, Qualtrics, user interviews, roadmapping,
  workflow automation.
- **Design & Front-end:** UI/UX, prototyping, design systems, usability testing,
  React.

## Selected projects

- [Wind Farm Location Optimizer](/project/wind-farm-location-optimizer): As an
  AI Fellow at AI4ALL, prototyped and trained a machine-learning model to
  optimize U.S. wind-farm siting from geospatial and environmental data. (AI/ML,
  Data Science — Python, Scikit-Learn.)
- [AI Impact on Student Writing](/project/ai-impact-student-writing): Research
  Assistant on UC Davis's PAIRR study; processed and cleaned survey data from
  500+ students and analyzed qualitative interviews to measure how AI tools
  affect student writing. (Data Science, Product.)
- [Reviving Downtown Davis](/project/reviving-downtown-davis): Led user research
  into why 30+ local businesses closed, then designed data-driven solutions to
  raise foot traffic and student engagement. (Product, Design.)
- [Verazoi UX Research](/project/verazoi-ux-research): UX research for a student
  startup via the PLASMA Accelerator; built a Qualtrics + Calendly workflow that
  automates interview scheduling. (Product, Design.)
- [COFFEE Club Website](https://coffeeatucd.com): Designed and built the homepage
  for UC Davis's Club of Female/Femme Electrical Engineers in Figma and React.
  (Design, Engineering.)
